title: App Store Optimisation & Mobile Growth
description: Optimise app store presence and design mobile growth loops. Tests ASO, push notifications, and in-app referral strategies.

seo.overviewTitle: App Store Optimization (ASO) & Mobile User Acquisition
seo.overviewBody: Mobile app marketing drives app downloads and user retention. Mobile marketers demonstrate skills in App Store Optimization (ASO for iOS App Store & Google Play), keyword optimization, app store screenshot conversion testing, and push notification retention flows.

deliverables.title: 1. App Store Optimization (ASO) Metadata Spec
deliverables.desc: ASO document specifying app title keywords, subtitle text, keyword field entries, and long description copy.

deliverables.title: 2. App Store Screenshot Conversion Brief
deliverables.desc: Design brief outlining app screenshot value callouts, visual framing, and A/B test variations.

deliverables.title: 3. Push Notification Retention Flow Blueprint
deliverables.desc: Automated push campaign series mapping onboarding nudges, feature discovery alerts, and inactive user win-backs.

faqs.question: How does ASO differ between the iOS App Store and Google Play Store?
faqs.answer: iOS uses a dedicated 100-character private keyword field. Google Play indexes keywords directly from the public short and long app descriptions.

faqs.question: How do app store screenshots affect conversion rates?
faqs.answer: Screenshots are the primary visual element users evaluate before tapping download; adding clear benefit captions over UI screens increases conversion by 15-30%.

faqs.question: What is an optimal push notification strategy?
faqs.answer: Send personalized, context-relevant notifications based on user actions, while offering opt-out controls to prevent uninstalls.
